Compared against reference text from General Site Plan Notes for COA.md Fire Department section. Notes 1, 3, 4, 6, and 7 semantically match the reference. Note 5 addresses combustible construction materials instead of commercial dumpsters.
findings.reasoning: The checklist requires ~90% semantic matching for the 7 Standard Austin Fire notes. Six of the seven notes are present and semantically equivalent, but note 5 is substantively different content. The reference requires a note about commercial dumpster placement near combustible features, while the plan has a note about combustible construction material placement. These address different safety concerns and are not semantically equivalent, failing to meet the ~90% threshold for this note.
findings.explanation: Fire Department note 5 about commercial dumpsters missing; plan has different note about combustible construction materials instead.
findings.resolution: Replace Fire Department note 5 on Sheet 5 with the required text: 'Commercial dumpsters and containers with an individual capacity of 1.5 cubic yards or greater shall not be stored or placed within ten feet of openings, combustible walls, or combustible eave lines.' See the CoA standard notes template (https://austin.widen.net/s/vxznrtmfwf/sp_consolidatedsiteplanapplication_notestemplates) for the expected notes.
